warrant: The graded histories and frames follow the general-tensor DG diffusion kernels (`dg_diffusion_gen`) in three configuration dimensions. In `rt_dg_diffusion_gen_3x.c`, `diffusion_coeff` (line 61) is `diffusion_coeff` scales the diffusion tensor; the two-ULP variant therefore moves every graded value at the level of the arithmetic, while a wrong diffusion tensor contraction, a wrong recovery stencil or a dropped cross term changes them at order one. The bound atol=1e-11, rtol=1e-11 was set on 2026-09-06 from the calibration selfcheck on the x86 worker 136.114.2.6 (1 cpu, 4 GB, Docker): the two-ULP variant used at most 5.8e-5 of it and the strict-IEEE altbuild at most 1.0e-4 (worst files `q.gkyl` and `q.gkyl`), a headroom of about 9906x over the larger legitimate perturbation, while the faults named above move the graded values at order one.
